title: BackupRunManifest
description: Authoritative record of one `aca backup run`. Written to the backup target at the environment-scoped well-known key `<prefix>/manifests/<environment>/latest.json`. This is the ONLY object written to the backup target that is not age-encrypted, so that a freshness reader holding no decryption identity can evaluate it. It therefore MUST NOT carry credentials of any kind.

environment.description: Environment that produced this manifest. MUST equal the environment segment of the manifest key; a reader whose own environment differs MUST reject the manifest.

overall_outcome.description: succeeded only when every store either succeeded or was explicitly not required. A manifest is not written at all for a run in which a required store failed; partial records a run whose non-successes were explicit skips.

retention_tier.description: Tier segment embedded in every artifact key of this run, chosen at write time by the documented promotion rule.

required.description: Whether a non-successful outcome for this store makes the whole run a failure.

reason.description: Named, closed reason for a skipped or failed store. Never free-form operator text and never a subprocess stderr body — stderr can echo a connection string.

allOf.description: A7 — a succeeded store MUST carry its key, size, and digest. Omitting them would make an empty upload indistinguishable from a good one.
A skipped store MUST name why it was skipped and MUST NOT claim an artifact.
A failed store MUST name why it failed.
